{{Regional Development tab}}
{{Hatnote|This article is about the locations and points of interest that contribute to Regional Development. For the placable constructs when using the [[Automated Industry Complex]] (AIC), see [[Facility]].}}
{{Incomplete data notice|This page's data is incomplete.}}

'''Facilities''' are locations and points of interest across the overworld in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

Facilities can be upgraded using each respective region's stock bills and provide additional activities, opportunities to obtain regional stock bills, or operator progression for the player. Facilities can be upgraded using each region's respective stock bills, providing additional [[Regional Development Metric]].

== All ==
The following '''facilities''' are shared across regions and can be upgraded using each region's respective Regional Stock Bills.

=== {{Icon|Automation-Core facility icon|text=false|size=30}} Outpost Management ===
'''[[Outpost]]s''' are facilities unlockable in several areas in [[Talos-II]] which unlocks the '''Trading''' and '''Outpost Defense''' activities for that area.

In '''Trading''', players can exchange [[AIC Products]] from their depot for Regional Stock Bills. Outposts can only "store" a limited amount of Regional Stock Bills at once for exchanging and generate more every hour, determined by the outpost's '''Base Earning Efficency'''. The maximum amount of Regional Stock Bills that can be "stored" is determined by the outpost's '''Stock Bill Capacity'''. The facility can be upgraded to unlock new tradable goods and increase the Base Earning Efficiency and Stock Bill Capacity of the outpost.

In '''Outpost Defense''', players select a level and defend the outpost against waves of enemies using [[Facility/Combat_&_Support|Combat Facilities]] to permanently earn permanent rewards, including the {{I|Combat Facilities Capacity|g=0}} for that area. Completing the '''Auto-Defense''' difficulty of a level also grants a permanent buff to the outpost that increases the amount of Regional Stock Bills earned through Trading.

=== {{Icon|Depot Node facility icon|text=false|size=30}} Depot Node ===
[[File:Depot_Node_Lvl_4.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Depot Node]]s''' are facilities unlockable in several areas in [[Talos-II]] which unlocks the '''Pack and Deliver''' activity for that area and increases the maximum depot size of each item. In '''Pack and Deliver''', players remove [[AIC Products]] from their depot and deliver them to set locations in the Depot Node's area in exchange for Regional Stock Bills. The facility can be upgraded to unlock additional delivery sizes and delivery types which increase the amount of Regional Stock Bills awarded for delivery but places additional player movement restrictions. Upgrading the facility also further increases the maximum depot size.

=== {{Icon|Stock Redistribution Terminal facility icon|text=false|size=30}} Stock Redistribution ===
[[File:SR_Terminal_Lucky_Carrot.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Stock Redistribution Terminal]]s''' are facilities unlockable in several areas in [[Talos-II]] which offer '''staple goods''' and '''elastic goods''' in exchange for Regional Stock Bills. '''Staple goods''' are items that can only be purchased once and items that can only be purchased in limited quantities every server week. '''Elastic goods''' are items which change in pricing every day but can be converted back to Regional Stock Bills to the current lower or higher pricing. Elastic goods can only be purchased in limited quantities every day. The facility can be upgraded to offer more goods and increase the amount of purchasable elastic goods every day.

=== {{Icon|Recycling Station facility icon|text=false|size=30}} Recycling Station ===
[[File:Recycling_Station_Small_Image.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Recycling Station]]s''' are facilities unlockable in several areas in [[Talos-II]] which regularly produce {{I|Aerospace Material I|g=0}} and {{I|Aerospace Material II|g=0}} which can be used to upgrade [[Dijiang]]. The materials have a short cooldown in-between collections. The facility can be upgraded to increase the amount of materials given per collection.

== Wuling ==
The following '''facilities''' are only available on [[Wuling]] and can only be upgraded using {{Currency|Wuling Stock Bill}} [[Wuling Stock Bill]]s.
=== {{Icon|Environment Monitoring Terminal facility icon|text=false|size=30}}Environment Monitoring ===
[[File:Environment_Monitoring_Tutorial_2.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Environment Monitoring]]''' facilities are facilities unlockable in [[Wuling City]] and [[Marker Stone]] that allow players to take '''monitoring jobs''' or photographs of notable objects across Wuling for {{Currency|Wuling Stock Bill}} [[Wuling Stock Bill]]s. Each facility creates a new monitoring job every few server days and stores it in a job slot.

If the amount of job slots are already filled, the oldest monitoring job is slotted out and the newest monitoring job is slotted in. The facility can be upgraded to increase the amount of job slots and the amount of Wuling Stock Bills awarded per job.

=== {{Icon|Purification Node facility icon|text=false|size=30}}Purification Node ===
[[File:Purification_Node_Tutorial_1.png|frameless|right]]
The '''[[Purification Node]]''' is a facility unlockable in the [[Test Area]] that can process and discard {{I|Sewage|g=0}}. The facility can be upgraded to increase the amount of available inlets.

At Facility Level 4, the {{I|Xircon Effluent|g=0}} outlet is unlocked. Inserted Sewage is converted into Xircon Effluent which can be retrieved through the output port. Increasing the amount of Sewage piped into the facility also increases the amount of Xircon Effluent created. If the output slot of the facility is full, the facility will continue to process Sewage inserted.

=== {{Icon|Trial Arena facility icon|text=false|size=30}}Trial of Swordmancy ===
[[File:Trial Arena Lvl 4.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Trial of Swordmancy]]''', also sometimes referred to in-game as the '''Trial Arena''', is a facility unlockable in [[Sword Vault Dale]] that allows players to battle enemies in rounds in exchange for {{Currency|Wuling Stock Bill}} [[Wuling Stock Bill]]s daily.

At Facility Level 2, '''Daily Rewards Doubling''' is unlocked which allows players to double their {{Currency|Wuling Stock Bill}} Wuling Stock Bills earned for that round a limited number of times per day. The facility can be upgraded to increase the amount Wuling Stock Bills collected per round daily and the amount of Daily Rewards Doubling attempts per day.

=== {{Icon|Typhoeus's Archery Range facility icon|text=false|size=30}}Typhoeus's Archery Range ===
[[File:Typhoeus archery cabin lv4.png|frameless|right]]
'''[[Typhoeus's Archery Range]]''', also sometimes referred to in-game as just the '''Archery Range''', is a facility unlockable in [[Snowy Forest]] that allows players to take control of [[Typhoeus]] and use the [[Archery]] tool to shoot moving targets within a set time limit. The facility can be upgraded to unlock permanent and daily replayable stages and to unlock recipes for Archery-based [[Personal Device]]s.
